reviewer_statement: Author-side six-domain native-language scientific source review against frozen Python 1.2. Exact developer-tested typed FunctionalRecoveryAssessment/Value/Metric numerical, semantic, nullable, Unicode and text outputs. Native R records/data.frame/string are numeric and semantic counterparts but not Python dataclass/pandas objects. Python exception type identity and arbitrary custom __str__/__repr__ object protocols are excluded; independent certification remains zero.
native_language_semantic_policy: Native R validated assessment lists/S3 records and R data.frame/text map frozen Python typed recovery records and pandas/string semantic fields. Explicit Python-boundary mode accepts source-like scalar text coercion and preserves the stricter ordinary R default. Never call reticulate in native production implementation.

case_evidence.description: Source function requires typed assessment; explicit Python-boundary R representation preserves required semantics
Native metric/value/assessment records accept normalized catalog and custom metric fields, Unicode, finite numerics, component/source labels and standard Python scalar string conversions
Direct frozen Python source typed oracle validates 4 records, numeric values, zero-based to one-based components, Unicode fields and null labels
Empty assessment, NaN/Inf, negative components, duplicate metric/component/source and bad semantic directions reject consistently with source constructors
Nine native R dataframe columns preserve source pandas column names, order, normalized strings, values and missing semantics
Descriptive known-truth semantic metrics keep explicit direction, units, scope, and labels without estimator retuning

language_specific_limits: Python pandas/dataclass identities do not exist in native R
Python arbitrary custom __repr__/__str__ and keyword binding are not native R protocols
Python ValueError/TypeError represented by native R conditions
